deviations_from_card: (1) setRecordStatus, undoStatus and applyUndo live in lib/db.ts, not lib/acts.ts: they write through the kit's server-only activity module and lib/acts.ts is imported by client components (README rule); acts.ts keeps the pure plan, the guarded-undo plan and the tool spec. applyUndo moved out of the 'use server' actions.ts so it is testable. (2) Seed ids are rec_0001 (rngFor id format), not rec-0001 as the card wrote; tests use the real ids. (3) Built on the r1 kit: the guarded undo returns the kit's UndoVerdict (ADR 0156) - partial naming the record left alone, or refused with blockedBy the later status act when nothing can be put back - and undoAction now passes UndoOptions/returns UndoAnswer fields so ActivityLog's 'Undo #n and this' and the toast's 'Undo both' work. (4) The tool handler resolves a domain refusal {ok:false,error} as an answer, per ADR 0146. (5) Guards 7-8 were red before only because the modules they import (lib/acts.ts, applyUndo export) did not exist; their behaviour premise held. (6) README: line 3 description and the app/actions.ts row corrected, one row appended at the table's end (slot A appends after it).
